title: Beyond Benchmarks: Evaluating Large Language Models and Agentic Patterns for Static Code Analysis Warning Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.19086v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Context: Static Code Analysis (SCA) tools support software verification and validation, reducing the time and cost of code reviews. However, the best SCA tools in the practitioner community generate a high volume of false positives, which developers tend to ignore, leading to genuine warnings being overlooked. Accordingly, studies increasingly adopt Large Language Models (LLMs) to identify and reduce false positives. Existing studies have produced promising results on public datasets, but underperformed on unseen datasets. Moreover, researchers do not leverage the full potential of Agentic patterns in LLMs or incorporate established code quality standards for warning classification. translated_title: 超越基准测试：评估大语言模型与智能体模式在静态代码分析警告分类中的应用
translated_abstract: 背景：静态代码分析（SCA）工具支持软件验证与确认，能够减少代码审查的时间和成本。然而，从业者社区中最好的SCA工具会产生大量误报，开发者往往会忽略这些误报，从而导致真正的警告被忽视。因此，越来越多的研究采用大语言模型（LLM）来识别和减少误报。现有研究在公开数据集上取得了有前景的结果，但在未见过的数据集上表现不佳。此外，研究人员没有充分利用LLM中智能体模式的全部潜力，也没有将已有的代码质量标准纳入警告分类中。目标：本研究利用四个手动标注的数据集，评估三个当代大语言模型在真实应用场景中进行SCA警告分类的性能，并结合智能体模式和既定编码标准来提升模型表现。
tldr: 本研究利用四个手动标注数据集评估三个当代大语言模型在真实场景下静态代码分析警告分类的性能，并通过引入智能体模式和既定编码标准来提升分类效果。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates three contemporary LLMs for static code analysis warning classification on real-world applications using four manually annotated datasets, enhancing performance through agentic patterns and established coding standards.
